tokens.name: bg-000
tokens.usage: Page canvas behind every panel. The deepest layer in Obsidian, the warm paper ground in Ivory.

tokens.name: bg-100
tokens.usage: Default panel, card and table surface, sitting on bg-000.

tokens.name: bg-200
tokens.usage: Raised surfaces: inputs, popovers, featured cards, table row hover.

tokens.name: bg-300
tokens.usage: Selected rows, bar tracks, pressed and hover fills for ghost and secondary buttons.

tokens.name: line-subtle
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers between rows and panels. Decorative only; never the sole edge of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Table header rules and section dividers. Decorative; use line-control for anything interactive.

tokens.name: line-control
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, secondary buttons and checkboxes. At least 3:1 on bg-000 to bg-200 in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and figures on bg-000 to bg-300.

tokens.name: ink-strong
tokens.usage: Titles, headings and the selected value in a list. Highest-contrast text; use ink for everything else.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, labels and overlines on bg-000 to bg-300.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Tertiary text: axis labels, timestamps, footnotes. Only on bg-000 to bg-200, never on bg-300.

tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: Gold as text, hairline, icon or chart line on bg-000 to bg-200 and gold-subtle. Spend on under 5% of a screen.

tokens.name: gold-fill
tokens.usage: Solid gold fill: the one primary button per view and the featured highlight. Text on it is on-gold.

tokens.name: on-gold
tokens.usage: Text and icons placed on gold-fill. 6:1 or better in both themes.

tokens.name: gold-subtle
tokens.usage: Tinted background behind gold text: fair-value badges, highlighted rows.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Intrinsic value, benchmarks and neutral secondary data series. Text or marks on bg-000 to bg-200.

tokens.name: info-subtle
tokens.usage: Background for info badges and callouts.

tokens.name: gain
tokens.usage: Positive change and undervaluation. A bluish green that stays off the red-green axis; always paired with a plus sign and the up glyph.

tokens.name: gain-subtle
tokens.usage: Background for gain badges and positive callouts.

tokens.name: loss
tokens.usage: Negative change and overvaluation. A vermillion; always paired with a minus sign and the down glyph.

tokens.name: loss-subtle
tokens.usage: Background for loss badges and error callouts.

tokens.name: chart-slate
tokens.usage: Third chart series and comparison lines when gold and info are taken.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 2px solid focus outline on every surface, at least 3:1 in both themes.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Overlay behind modals and drawers.

families.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, monospace

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Hero statements and the wordmark. One per page.

styles.name: display-lg
styles.usage: Page titles and company names on a research page.

styles.name: heading-lg
styles.usage: Panel titles on dashboards. Never for numerals.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: Earnings quality is high and capital allocation is disciplined.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Free cash flow covers dividends 2.4 times.

styles.name: overline
styles.usage: Uppercase labels above figures and table headers. Set in capitals via CSS.

styles.name: figure-xl
styles.usage: The single hero figure of a view.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gaps, glyph spacing.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gaps inside controls and badges.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Table cell vertical padding, tight stacks.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Table cell horizontal padding, form field gaps.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Compact card padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Default card padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gaps between cards.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Page gutters on desktop.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Section spacing.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Hero and report-cover spacing.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Badges and tags.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons and inputs.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards and panels.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Modals and drawers only.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Bar tracks, toggles and filter chips.

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Maximum width of the page grid. Twelve columns up to this width.

tokens.name: motion-fast
tokens.usage: Hover and focus transitions. The only motion in the system; no entrance animations or autoplay.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Resting raised controls.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: Popovers and raised cards.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: Modals and drawers.

tokens.name: shadow-gold
tokens.usage: The one featured card per view; a gold hairline with a faint halo.
